description: Build it Better: the public line for 'Turn your App into a Startup'. It is an auction — the highest bid is first, equal bids go to whoever bid first, applications with no bid follow in arrival order. Bids are in ET10 and are never collected. Returns each startup's position, name and bid, and the rules. Read-only, no auth.
name: bb_startup_line
title: Bb Startup Line
